sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Full-length tagged protein detected by western blot with anti-HA and anti-V5 in stable HEK293 cells (L3, L4). Constructs used to study SPPL2a-mediated intramembrane proteolysis of CD74; processing fragments detected. Surface expression not explicitly measured by flow cytometry or surface biotinylation. MHC-II chaperoning function NOT MEASURED.
sites.rationale: CD74 is a Type II transmembrane protein with its entire C-terminal domain (residues 73–296) extracellular; a tag appended after the final residue (M296) is therefore on the cell surface. The paper uses a murine ortholog (p31 isoform), making this indirect evidence, but the C-terminal topology is conserved. Python confirms seq[295]='M' and seq[294]='P', placing the junction unambiguously after M296. No residue number is named in the paper, so position_evidence is topology_derived: for a C-terminal tag there is exactly one extracellular terminus. PMC3549707 generated two full-length membrane-anchored murine CD74 p31 constructs stably expressed in HEK293 cells: HA-mCD74p31-V5 (V5 at C-terminus) and mCD74p31-HA (HA at C-terminus). CD74 is a Type II single-pass TM protein whose C-terminus (residues 73–296 in the human canonical sequence) is extracellular. No residue number is stated for the junction; the position is derived from the fact that exactly one extracellular terminus exists and the tag is placed there.

sources.claim: Based on this template, two epitope-tagged expression constructs of the shorter and more abundant p31 isoform (HA-mCD74p31-V5 and mCD74p31-HA) were generated by overlap-extension PCR.

literature_notes: All five ledger lines derive from a single paper (PMC3549707) studying SPPL2a-mediated cleavage of murine CD74 p31. Two tag positions are described: HA at the cytoplasmic N-terminus (intracellular, moved to other_positions) and V5 or HA at the extracellular C-terminus (the one surface site reported here). The murine p31 isoform lacks 16 aa encoded by exon 6 relative to the human p33 canonical sequence, but the C-terminal tag position is isoform-independent. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for CD74. Confidence is medium rather than high because (a) the evidence is from a murine ortholog, (b) no explicit surface-expression assay is reported in the clips, and (c) the p31 isoform differs from the human canonical p33.

literature_other_positions.note: HA tag fused to the N-terminus of mCD74p31 (HA-mCD74p31-V5); the N-terminus of CD74 (residues 1–47) is cytoplasmic in this Type II TM protein, so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface site.
